purpose: Teach: 呪術/プラチナ/奏法/水力/日没/縫製/体外/亜鉛

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の呪術的思考を医療チームで尊重しつつ説明します
lines.en: Ren, we work as a medical team to respect our patients' spiritual beliefs while providing medical explanation.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Professional warmth without condescension. Slight pause before 'we work as a team' — establishing collaborative ground. Steady eye contact. Matter-of-fact confidence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、プラチナ系抗がん剤を医療チームで処方します
lines.en: Yes, we'll be prescribing platinum-based chemotherapy as part of the treatment plan.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Direct but not blunt. The tone of someone who has delivered this information many times and carries the weight of it carefully. Even pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、リハビリでピアノ奏法を医療チームで活用します
lines.en: Ren, in your rehabilitation we're going to incorporate piano playing — it can be quite therapeutic as part of your overall recovery.
lines.style: Warm but clinical. Slight lift on 'piano playing' — genuine interest in the therapeutic angle. Calm conviction that this will help. Unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、水力的なマッサージ機を医療チームで採用します
lines.en: Yes, we'll be adding hydrotherapy massage to your treatment regimen.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Professional certainty. A small nod implicit in the voice. The briefer, more settled tone of confirming standard care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 日没後のうつ傾向を、貴院、診られますね、先生
lines.en: You've noticed the low mood in the evenings — our hospital does catch that, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant. Testing whether the doctor has observed what he's observed. Soft, genuine curiosity — not accusatory. A small pause before 'doesn't it' as if checking the question is fair.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、手術衣の縫製仕様を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Yes, we maintain strict standards for surgical gown materials and seaming specifications across the entire team.
lines.style: Procedural certainty. Clinical detail without performance. Slight emphasis on 'standards' — the pride of a well-run operation. Even, professional tone throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 体外受精のカウンセリングを、貴院、おこなわれますね、先生
lines.en: Does your hospital offer counseling for fertility treatments, Doctor?
lines.style: Respectful inquiry, slightly formal. A genuine question underneath — something he's wondering about or concerned about. Quiet, not rushed. The tone of someone who respects the answer will take time.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、亜鉛剤の処方を医療チームで活用します
lines.en: Yes, zinc supplementation is part of our comprehensive support protocol.
lines.style: Close, reassuring affirmation. Warmth near the surface but still held in professional frame. As if saying 'we take care of the details.' Gentle, unhurried pace.
